J2.evidence: The source only quotes the Kufan version «يا مَرْحَباهُ بِجَمّارِ ناجِيَةٍ» and gives no gloss. TR adds '(Merhaba Nâciye'nin taş atıcısına [ya da deveci topluluğuna]!)': the bracketed alternative 'deveci topluluğu' is an unmarked addition and is doubtful (camel-drivers would be جَمّال, not جَمّار), and 'taş atıcısı' is itself a speculative choice. The alternative/uncertainty must be inside a [Mütercim notu: …] (or the gloss limited to a cautious rendering marked as such). Rest of the TR is faithful.

J1.evidence: For «يا مَرْحَباهُ بِجَمّارِ ناجِيَةٍ», TR gives '(Merhaba Nâciye'nin taş atıcısına [ya da deveci topluluğuna]!)'. The bracketed alternative gloss is an unmarked addition not in the Arabic, which gives no meaning for جمّار. It must be put in a [Mütercim notu: ...].
